purpose: Correct two V0.1 source-validation overconstraints without changing the event population, source bytes, source transport, economic hypothesis, or opening any market outcome.

correction_1_timestamp_precision.v01_overconstraint: V0.1 required exact-second equality between the Binance CMS publishDate and a reconnaissance timestamp previously serialized only to minute precision.
correction_1_timestamp_precision.parent_authority_requirement: Every event must have an original public publication timestamp; it did not require a lower-precision reconnaissance rendering to be authoritative at the second level.
correction_1_timestamp_precision.v02_rule: The official Binance CMS data.publishDate full-second UTC value becomes the canonical event timestamp. The earlier reconnaissance timestamp is treated as a minute-precision preview and must equal floor_to_minute(CMS publishDate).

correction_2_project_number_text.v01_overconstraint: V0.1 additionally required the ordinal project number to appear literally inside every article response.
correction_2_project_number_text.parent_authority_requirement: All project numbers 31 through 63 must be accounted for with zero duplicate numbers and zero unresolved numbering gaps; it did not require each article body to literally restate its number.
correction_2_project_number_text.v02_rule: Project-number completeness is validated by the frozen one-to-one 31..63 mapping in the pre-outcome reconnaissance. Article-body identity requires fixed article code, Launchpool context, expected symbol, BNB, and staking/locking/farming language; literal ordinal text is diagnostic only.

after_source_pass_only.next_step: Freeze a separate event-mechanism Discovery protocol before opening BNBBTC or any other market price field.
